Dragalge

Poison Dragon

Kalos · Generation 6

Dragalge is a Poison/Dragon-type Mock Kelp Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 81.5 kg. It evolves from Skrelp. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (123), with a base stat total of 494.
